links.outcome: Head-to-head comparison of two LLMs on diagnostic accuracy, classification and reasoning on the same cases
links.effect: Accuracy 85.4% GPT-5.3 vs 75.0% Gemini (P=0.306); reasoning 4.4±0.6 vs 3.9±0.7 (P=0.011); kappa 0.675 vs 0.628.
links.quote: GPT-5.3 scored higher than Gemini in overall clinical reasoning (4.4 ± 0.6 vs. 3.9 ± 0.7, P = 0.011).

links.outcome: Error patterns and unsafe outputs, including reduced accuracy on borderline cases
links.effect: Both models had low rates of unsafe outputs, Gemini slightly higher; accuracy reduced on borderline cases (ocular hypertension, suspected glaucoma, early POAG); Gemini overdiagnosed more.
links.quote: Both models had low rates of unsafe outputs, though Gemini showed a slightly higher proportion.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the diagnostic accuracy, reasoning, and error patterns of two commercial LLMs (GPT-5.3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro) on standardized clinical vignettes without testing a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
